_notes: events/ and current/ intentionally have NO expiration: events/ is the product's permanent change-memory; current/ is the small always-overwritten latest-state + source-status. raw/ is the court-of-record: cools to Standard-IA at 90d, expires at 400d (V1 learning scale keeps ~13 months of raw). normalized/ is replayable from raw so it expires at 90d. reports/ kept 180d (tiny). NO versioning anywhere (operator hard rule) — immutability comes from unique write-once keys, not versions. Adjust the day counts together before applying if you want a longer raw window.
